title: Lots of Do's and Don'ts
text:
Lots of Do's and Don'ts. The first thing that struck me about this pan was the list of things that you shouldn't do to it. The first being no high heat because that will burn off the finish. Don't rap utensils on the edge. You can put it in the dishwasher, but don't. Heat it slowly. So many rules that it is unlikely I will use this very much.
It is well made, pretty heavy bottomed, and does clean up easily. I used it to do some sauteed vegetables and used a Calphalon lid that I had. It did clean up easily and if you don't cook much this is probably a good pan for you. I cook almost everyday/ 365 so I prefer cookware without all the caveats.
